thread:
Nina: Tiny appreciation shoutout 12 to Carlos and Juno for helping the new hire onboarding yesterday. they stayed an extra hour to pair through the SDK example and fixed the CI flakes. also brought bagels :bagel: which is forever appreciated.
Carlos: haha bagels are a negotiating tool. glad we could help Juno onboarded super smoothly. welcome again!
Juno: big thanks!! the pair session made the SDK example click. CI fix was a lifesaver.
Marta: noticing this thread late but wanted to echo thanks. onboarding went much faster than expected. team win. :clap:
people-ops: sending a small swag bundle and a shoutout badge to Carlos & Nina for mentorship. check email for details. :tada:
snack-bot: Bagel credit applied to Carlos (1) and Nina (1). Redeem at pantry.
Nina: omg swag + bagels, peak recognition. thank you people-ops & snack-bot.
Carlos: appreciation noted. tip for docs team 12 I'll add the CI flakiness fix to the README under "running tests locally":
```
# run only the integration suite
pytest tests/integration -k streaming --maxfail=1 -q
```
Juno: added a small comment to the SDK example PR as well so future hires see the gotcha.
Marta: Would someone mind if we throw a quick 2-question poll in #random tomorrow: "best onboarding snack"? purely scientific. :popcorn:
Nina: do it. i'll campaign for bagels. :bagel:
Carlos: team bagels forever.
Juno: thanks again everyone. excited to be here. :grin:
